title: Income Tax (TFN Withholding Tax (ESS)) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would increase withholding tax on employee share scheme income where an individual has not supplied a tax file number or Australian Business Number.
It would raise the applicable tax rate from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent, incorporating the increase in the Medicare levy.
The change would cover share scheme interests provided from 1 July 2014 and accompany the wider package of DisabilityCare Australia tax amendments.
changes: The statutory withholding rate would rise by half a percentage point.
The rate calculation would incorporate a Medicare levy component of 2 per cent.
The new rate would apply to employee share scheme interests provided on or after 1 July 2014.
summary.affected: Individuals receiving employee share scheme interests without quoting either tax identifier are affected.

speeches.speaker: David Bradbury
speeches.brief: Moved the Income Tax (TFN Withholding Tax (ESS)) Amendment (DisabilityCare Australia) Bill, proposing that withholding tax on discounted employee shares or rights rise from 46.5 per cent to 47 per cent from 1 July 2014, with revenue supporting DisabilityCare Australia.

speeches.speaker: Jacinta Collins
speeches.brief: Moved to suspend standing orders so that 14 bills related to DisabilityCare Australia (the National Disability Insurance Scheme) could be considered during the current sitting period; the motion was agreed to.
